capabilities: number headings hierarchically (e.g. 1.1.1) across a configurable, contiguous heading-level range
renumber documents automatically on edit or open after a configurable delay
override global settings per document with one compact frontmatter line, or opt out with off
remove all numbering prefixes with one command
save current settings to a document's frontmatter
extras: Bilingual (Chinese/English) interface and settings. Known limitation: headings whose text starts with a number/letter plus separator (e.g. '2.0 Release Notes') may have that prefix misidentified as an old number and stripped; opt out per document with frontmatter off. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.

problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to number headings hierarchically or keep those numbers updated automatically as a document is edited.
